description: Defines the TServerFramework class, which provides a consolidated processing loop for Thrift servers, managing client connections, disconnections, and concurrency limits.

classes.name: TServerFramework
classes.description: A server class that manages client connections and concurrency for Thrift servers, providing methods to serve, stop, and configure client limits.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Starts accepting clients and processing requests.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Interrupts serve() to stop the server.

methods.name: getConcurrentClientLimit
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of concurrent clients allowed.

methods.name: getConcurrentClientCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of connected clients.

methods.name: getConcurrentClientCountHWM
methods.description: Returns the highest number of concurrent clients reached.

methods.name: setConcurrentClientLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent clients.
